name: smwmusic-fire-emblem-genealogy-of-the-holy-war-tine-s-theme
title: Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War - Tine's Theme
description:
A short yet turbulent tune from Genealogy that plays during certain conversations. Might be good for a world map theme or cutscene.

Comes with an option to either play at the original volume or match the channel volume values to the original SPC, the latter of which will be louder due to a difference in master volume between SMW and FE4.
